recBE7KwrPCyVVZMU.Bio: Gabriel, known on air as Slick Dissident, co-hosts InnerVerse's Vibe Rant show and is a longtime recurring guest on the podcast. He is best known for Tarot-tories, his own system mapping the 22 Major Arcana and zodiac archetypes onto the geography of the United States.

fields.Core Themes JSON: [{"title": "Opening Sacred Space With the Four Directions", "body": "Kerri Hummingbird began the show by opening sacred space, calling in the south, west, north and east along with Mother Earth, Father Sky, plant and animal allies and her ancestors. She said she asked for help each day and told her students that days went better when they said yes to connection. Later she explained that her new book, Inner Medicine, followed the same medicine wheel, built around the four directions and a spiral, with a story opening each section. She described the book as a ceremony and said readers and listeners would receive its frequency work."}, {"title": "Initiation, Motherhood, and the Placenta", "body": "Chance argued that the placenta was a baby's guardian angel and twin, and that a culture treating it as biohazard waste might leave that guardian spirit traumatized. Kerri said she had not been initiated into womanhood, so her family marked her daughter's passage with a sweat lodge. She argued that people needed initiations into each stage of life or they stayed stuck there, and that modern mothers lacked the wise women's circles indigenous communities once offered. Chance said that tracing family patterns back through the ancestral line often showed the same struggle repeating for generations."}, {"title": "Wordplay, Law, and Hidden Ritual", "body": "Chance linked the word cyst to a basket and to the placenta, and argued that birth is an anagram of tribe, and Gabe later remarked on how often such threads led back to the placenta. When the talk turned to medical induction, one speaker said the word induction was an occult term meaning initiation, and read an 1828 dictionary definition to make the point. The same speaker said science called ritual a procedure, which was the same thing in another language, then claimed that the birth certificate and citizenship functioned as a type of black magic that gave people a paper identity in place of their inner one."}, {"title": "Fractal Lines and Healing Through Friction", "body": "Kerri drew on the Gene Keys to argue that every ancestral line was a fractal, and that when opposite lines met, the friction cleared distortion from both and led toward harmony. She said people could now discuss hot topics that had been impossible decades earlier. A later speaker, answering Kerri, described the liminal space, where one peeked through the veil, as a place where everything looked fractal, and said that seeing a family line as a wave was how such traumas could be healed. The same speaker tied the spiral of a pattern to seven generations."}, {"title": "Animal Allies, Fire, and Owl Medicine", "body": "Kerri told how a vision of a hummingbird led to the name Kerri Hummingbird, and described the hummingbird, jaguar, serpent and condor as primary shamanic allies. Chance noted that an ancient Mexican flood story sent out a hummingbird in place of a dove, and the conversation tied the bird's name Colibri to Calabria. Kerri described calling on vulture to cleanse old toxic energy and said the spots where fire marked her feet taught her what her body needed. She urged listeners not to try firewalking at home. Gordy described being gifted an owl wing."}]
fields.Intro Paragraph 1: Kerri Hummingbird joins Vibe Rant to discuss her new book, Inner Medicine. As the host of the Soul Nectar show, an energy worker and shamanic teacher, Kerri provides guidance for the path of the healers and whole-ness keepers. Owl-master Gordy will also be on board tonight to add his insights to our talk about connecting to the land and the four directions.
